name: parallelism-stays-off-the-shared-scheme
find:
PostRollTests:
    build:
      targets:
        PostRollTests: [test]
    test:
      targets:
        - PostRollTests
replace:
PostRollTests:
    build:
      targets:
        PostRollTests: [test]
    test:
      targets:
        - name: PostRollTests
          parallelizable: true
breaks: parallel testing moves into the scheme, which tools/check_guards.py also runs, so all 60-odd Swift guard entries lose the executed-tests total they are classified by and every one reports ERROR instead of a verdict (#992)
